summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K to disclose a routine quarterly earnings announcement to the Indian stock exchanges. The filing references transcripts of the media and earnings calls regarding financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a standard earnings disclosure with no extraordinary event triggering a special-situation classification.
